forcedChoices.choice: «tú ya has aprendido», «anda por él», «Dios mora en ti»
forcedChoices.reason: Jesus speaks to John alone in this paragraph (6.2 'My son'); English 'you' does not mark number.
Job speaks to his three friends.
Spanish needs an adjective; «malos» keeps the same moral range as English 'evil' here.

forcedChoices.choice: «¿No comprendes…!» keeps the English exclamation mark
forcedChoices.reason: The English closes a question with '!'; Spanish allows ¿…! for an exclamatory question.
